title: Kub's Improvements
description: Adds QoL small things to do the game like smelting rotten flesh for food, or recipes that just make sense
body:
Kub's Improvements is a mod, that aims to improve minecraft's features, without destroying the vanilla feel. Currently it's still in development, and I intend to add a lot more stuff.

Current features:

-  Cooking rotten flesh for food
-  Nether and End beds **[IN PROGRESS]**
-  And other small improvements
